entities.summary: Nancy Oliver is an American playwright and screenwriter who is best known for creating the 2022 miniseries Angelyne and her work on the successful TV series Six Feet Under. Oliver was nominated for the Academy Award for Best Original Screenplay in 2008 for her debut screenplay, Lars and the Real Girl.
